title: Surrender of license and seal.
officialText:
Upon the death or the retirement of a licensed special electrician, or upon the surrender, revocation, or suspension of their license, such license and seal shall immediately be surrendered to the commissioner.

(L.L. 2024/128, 12/21/2024, eff. 12/21/2025)
